entities.name: Bifunctional shikimate kinase/DHQS
observations: 605-aa query has 38.3% identity and 92.2% coverage to reviewed Bifidobacterium longum Q8G5X4, annotated bifunctional shikimate kinase/3-dehydroquinate synthase.
Sequence Pfam hits: SKI PF01202; DHQ_synthase PF01761; DHQS_C PF24621.
Homology-derived annotations indicate NAD(+) and a divalent metal cation as cofactors; not experimentally verified for this query.

entities.name: RHEA:13121
observations: Shikimate + ATP = 3-phosphoshikimate + ADP + H(+); shikimate kinase reaction, assigned through homolog Q8G5X4.

entities.name: RHEA:21968
observations: 7-phospho-2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-arabino-heptonate = 3-dehydroquinate + phosphate; 3-dehydroquinate synthase reaction, assigned through homolog Q8G5X4.
